classification.difficultyReason: Construct figures from coordinates, classify their geometry and extract suitable bases and perpendicular heights, especially for the slanted parallelogram; also recognise perpendicular oblique lines.

content.prompt: Draw coordinate axes and mark on them the integer points 1 cm apart.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(0,1)$, $B(3,1)$, $C(3,4)$ and $D(0,4)$, and join them to form $AB$, $BC$, $CD$ and $DA$. Describe the shape formed and evaluate its area.

answer.worked:
Plot and join the labelled vertices as shown. Each side is $3\text{ cm}$ and adjacent sides meet at right angles, so the shape is a square.
$$\begin{align*}A&=3\times3\\A&=9\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed square on unit-spaced coordinate axes.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(-2,0)$, $B(4,0)$ and $C(1,4)$, and join them to form $AB$, $BC$ and $CA$. Describe the shape formed and evaluate its area.

answer.worked:
Plot and join the labelled vertices as shown. The vertex $C$ lies directly above the midpoint of $AB$, so the triangle is isosceles. Its base is $6\text{ cm}$ and its perpendicular height is $4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times6\times4\\A&=12\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed isosceles triangle on a unit coordinate grid.
spec.mathematics: A(-2,0), B(4,0), C(1,4); base 6 cm, height 4 cm; area 12 cm².

children.label: c
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(-4,-4)$, $B(7,-4)$, $C(7,1)$ and $D(-4,1)$, and join them to form $AB$, $BC$, $CD$ and $DA$. Describe the shape formed and evaluate its area.

answer.worked:
Plot and join the labelled vertices as shown. Opposite sides are parallel and equal, and all four angles are right angles, so the shape is a rectangle. Its length is $11\text{ cm}$ and width is $5\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=11\times5\\A&=55\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed rectangle with equal horizontal and vertical coordinate scales.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(-6,4)$, $B(-1,4)$ and $C(-6,1)$, and join them to form $AC$, $CB$ and $BA$. Describe the shape formed and evaluate its area.

answer.worked:
Plot and join the labelled vertices as shown. The horizontal side $AB$ and vertical side $AC$ meet at a right angle at $A$. The perpendicular sides have lengths $5\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12\times5\times3\\A&=7.5\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed right-angled triangle in the second quadrant.
spec.mathematics: A(-6,4), B(-1,4), C(-6,1); perpendicular sides 5 cm and 3 cm.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(0,2)$ and $B(1,4)$, and draw the line passing through them. Now plot the points $C(-2,5)$ and $D(0,4)$, and draw the line passing through these points. Describe the relationship between the lines.

answer.short: The lines are perpendicular: they meet at right angles.
answer.worked: Plot $A$ and $B$ and extend their straight line. On the same axes, plot $C$ and $D$ and extend their straight line. The lines meet at a right angle, so they are perpendicular.

spec.description: Both completed straight lines share one equal-scale coordinate grid; arrows indicate continuation.
spec.mathematics: Line AB passes through (0,2) and (1,4); line CD passes through (-2,5) and (0,4). They intersect at right angles. Equations are used only to construct the diagram, not as the student method.

children.label: f
children.prompt: Plot the points $A(0,1)$, $B(4,3)$, $C(10,3)$ and $D(6,1)$, and join them to form $AB$, $BC$, $CD$ and $DA$. Describe the shape formed and evaluate its area.

answer.worked:
Plot and join the labelled vertices as shown. Both pairs of opposite sides are parallel, so the shape is a parallelogram. The horizontal base is $6\text{ cm}$ and the perpendicular height is $2\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=6\times2\\A&=12\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Completed parallelogram with unit grid and equal coordinate scales.
spec.mathematics: A(0,1), B(4,3), C(10,3), D(6,1); horizontal base 6 cm and perpendicular height 2 cm.
